post.summary: [Company] List Employee Missed Punch-Out Requests for Review
post.description: Company fetches all employee punch-out regularization requests for verification and review. Strictly restricted to the authenticated company.

post.summary: [Company] Approve or Reject Employee Missed Punch-Out Request
post.description: Company verifies and approves or rejects employee missed punch-out request. Only company admin can access. If approved, actual punch-out time is saved. If rejected, reason is mandatory and company can select reject_attendance_type as 'Halfday' or 'Absent' which updates employee attendance accordingly.

reject_reason.example: Punchout time does not match security entry register

reject_attendance_type.description: Mandatory/Used if rejected: Mark as 'Halfday' or 'Absent'
